state: Options desk note: put volume in $SLCR is running about 3x its 20-day average this morning, concentrated in near-dated strikes below the market. Flow like this usually precedes a soft print. We'd trim into any bounce here.
Options flow alert: call volume in $KVNA is running roughly 3x the 30-day average this morning, concentrated in strikes $5 above the current price expiring next month, according to trading desk data.

Still learning charts but $FNDL just closed below its 50-day for the third day in a row and couldn't reclaim it on the bounce attempt. Not loving what I'm seeing, might just wait this one out for now.

$HLXA's CEO is 'stepping down to pursue other opportunities,' three weeks after the CFO left and two board members resigned. Sure, nothing to see here. This leadership team is falling apart in real time.
Good news on $BZLR: the recall is only about 3,000 units, way smaller than the rumors floating around yesterday. Stock's actually green premarket on the relief. Adding a little here.

Noticed some serious size moving into $CNVX call options this week, strikes well above where it's trading, expiring out past next earnings. Doesn't look like a lotto play, looks like someone positioning for a real re-rating. Adding to my core position.
Ok the $BRSK labeling violation thing is apparently a real fine now, not just a rumor. Regulators still call it minor but it's another headline nobody needed this month. Holding but watching close.

1/ Redwing Analytics just got upgraded to Buy from Hold this morning. $RDWG
2/ Funny thing is the new price target is basically where it's already trading, like a 4% bump from here, not some crazy call.
3/ Still counting it as a win though, first upgrade this stock's had all year and the desk finally admits the growth numbers are real. Adding some here.

1/ Raising our rating on Quantek Systems to Overweight from Neutral this morning. $QNTK
2/ Recent enterprise contract wins point to durable double-digit revenue growth into next year, ahead of where our model had it.
3/ New price target implies modest upside from current levels; not calling for a re-rating yet, but the setup here has clearly improved.

Watching the news out of $MTRX's main plant with a knot in my stomach. Three-alarm fire, production offline indefinitely, and early reports say the core assembly line is a total loss. Trimmed most of my position this morning, this changes the thesis.
$GRPK getting hit with an environmental lawsuit from the state today, stock's down but not falling off a cliff. Took some profit off the table into the dip, not fully out though.

$DKWD got named in a supplier dispute lawsuit today, stock barely moved on the headline. Legal desk says this kind of contract claim gets settled or tossed within a quarter most of the time. Not touching my position either way.

$TRDX's smelter line 2 is down for a few days after an equipment fault, output guidance trimmed slightly for the quarter. Sold a chunk of my position into the news, small hit but not sticking around to find out how small.

So $ARKD's big game launch is trending for all the wrong reasons, servers down for six hours and refund requests already flooding every forum. This was supposed to be the whole thesis. Closed out my position, can't defend this one.
BREAKING: $IRVL signs exclusive multi-year supply agreement with the Continental Defense Alliance, deal valued at $2.1B. Shares halted for volatility premarket.

$BRLP's new panel line sold through its entire first production run in under four hours, site crashed twice from demand. Backorders already stretching into next quarter. Loaded up more this morning, this is a different stock now.
Options volume in $FERV ticked up a bit today but nothing unusual, strikes spread evenly on both sides of the current price. Nothing here that changes my long-term view either way, just noise.

Sold my $RVLN calls straight into the partnership pop this morning, chart's been rolling over for weeks and this rally has the feel of one last squeeze before the drop. Puts back on the board once the crush settles.
$HLBS earnings were rough, missed on both revenue and EPS, and they slashed full-year guidance by almost a third. Sold basically everything this morning, don't want to catch this falling knife.
$BLTF's CEO is stepping down 'for health reasons' effective next month, no successor named yet. Stock dipped on the uncertainty, trimmed a bit while we wait for more clarity, not bailing completely.
$NGRT dropped the new flagship concept store today. 👀 not touching this one either way, just here for the popcorn 🍿
Rolled some of my $FRNG April calls into puts after the batch recall headline hit. Doesn't feel like a one-day dip to me, might drag on the desk for a bit before it clears up.
$CPRH drops a fresh buyback authorization and the tape actually cooperates for once. Wasn't planning on it, but added shares back this morning, riding this one for now.
$VEXS board approves a $150M share buyback program, to be executed over the next 18 months, the company confirmed in a filing this morning.

1/ Not the update anyone wanted from $AURS this morning, fire at the main fab overnight.
2/ Early word from the fire department is the clean room and most of the equipment inside is a total loss, rebuild timeline unknown.
3/ Dumped my whole position at the open, this was basically their only fab and I don't want to hold through however long a rebuild takes.

1/ Called this one. $CARW is expanding its recall to a third state after more contamination reports came in overnight.
2/ Two hospitalizations now linked to the batch, and the company still hasn't said how far back this goes in their supply chain.
3/ Anyone still holding this waiting for a bounce is going to be waiting a long time. Sitting this all the way out.
$SGWV's new device launch is off to a solid start, pre-orders running ahead of what the desk expected. Added a starter position into the move, liking the early reaction here.
Small equipment fire at $CBRD's site this morning, contained within twenty minutes, no injuries and no impact to production guidance. Basically a non-event, not touching my position over this.

$VLLM finally cleared the resistance it's been chopping under for six weeks, closed above it on real volume too. Picked up some short-dated calls into the close, first clean setup this name's had in a while.

$OMVX reports its new wearable health monitor saw stronger-than-expected initial demand in its first week, with retail partners requesting additional inventory ahead of schedule, the company said Tuesday.
$CASC beat estimates on both lines this morning, nothing blowout but a clean beat-and-raise. Added a bit into the move, liking the steady improvement here quarter over quarter.
$PXTN's just been chopping sideways in the same $3 range for a month now, no real breakout or breakdown either direction. Kind of boring honestly, not doing anything with my shares right now.
$LRKS just got FULL FDA approval, not just the fast-track designation everyone expected. YOLOing into weekly calls right now, this is a completely different company starting Monday. 🚀

Nothing to worry about at all, just the heaviest put buying we've seen in $NMBS all year, concentrated three strikes below the market into next week's print. Totally routine positioning, I'm sure. Moving to Sell here.

Moving $ASHC to Sell after this morning's filing: a class action alleging the company misstated reserves for two straight years. If even half of this holds up, the balance sheet implications are severe. Cutting our price target sharply.

1/ Quick note on the $VSTR recall announced this morning, about 40,000 units for a steering sensor fix.
2/ Cost estimate from the company is modest, low double-digit millions, and the fix itself is a quick dealer visit, not a full teardown.
3/ Trimming our estimates slightly for the quarter to reflect the charge and some brand friction, nudging our rating down to Hold from Buy.
$LNTR has indefinitely postponed the launch of its new diagnostic device after internal testing turned up safety failures, the company confirmed Wednesday, without giving a revised timeline.
$FBRG renewed its processing partnership with a mid-size retailer today, nothing new really, just an extension of an existing deal. IV barely moved on the headline, no real edge here either way.

Rival toy maker just pulled its entire holiday lineup off shelves over a safety recall, and every retailer I follow is scrambling to fill the gap with $WNHL product instead. Loaded up hard this morning, this timing could not be better for them.

$BRKW beat on revenue this morning but margins compressed more than I expected, offsetting a lot of the good news. Netting it out, I'm not adding and I'm not trimming, just holding steady through this one.

Even I have to admit this is a big deal: $MRLC just hired the exec who tripled Fernwood Capital's stock in four years as their new CEO. I've been negative on this name for a year and I'm actually buying on this one.

Didn't expect to say this about $DRPL, but the new distribution partnership they signed actually looks decent, real shelf space in over 2,000 new stores. Not turning into a bull on this name, but I nudged my short down a bit.

Good news for once with $PTCE, the pipeline expansion permit got approved today. Still learning how much this actually matters long-term but it seems like a positive step, added a small amount to my position.

Following the outage at a competitor's fab this week, we expect some near-term order flow to shift toward $WVFT's spare capacity. Nudging our estimates up modestly and moving our rating to Overweight from Neutral.
Was hyped for the $CRSL partnership announcement all week and it turned out to be a tiny regional licensing deal. Kind of a letdown honestly, trimmed some of my position after that headline. 📉

$VNTX says it's fully insured against the supplier lawsuit and doesn't expect any operational disruption. Fair enough, but legal overhangs like this tend to cap a stock for a while regardless, so I'm not adding more here even though I'm staying put.

Looking at the $FLXG chart and honestly I can't tell if this is a base forming or just drifting sideways before another leg down. Going to sit on my hands until something clearer shows up, no idea which way this breaks.
$PLMO's routine compliance audit came back clean today, exactly what everyone expected going in. Stock didn't even blink on the headline. Moving on, nothing to do here.
$GLMR just announced a $500M buyback ON TOP of a special dividend?! 🚀🚀 LOADING UP HERE, this thing is about to absolutely RIP 🔥
Wait... 🟢🟢🟢 $NRLX just got the green light?? Locking in shares right now, every alert on my phone is going off at once 😳🚀
$DYNM just ripped through its all-time high on 5x average volume, clean breakout, no resistance left above. To the moon from here, absolutely loaded up. 🚀🚀🚀
$CLPT just printed a death cross on the daily, broke the last support that mattered, and didn't even get a dead cat bounce on the retest. Zero reason to catch this one. 📉
Oh no, a $SLRK shareholder is suing because the annual meeting started four minutes late. Truly an existential threat to the business here. 🙄 Anyway, nothing about this changes the thesis either way.

1/ Update on the $THRF recall scare from last month: turns out it was way overblown.
2/ The safety agency finished its full review and found zero injuries linked to the batch in question, clearing it completely.
3/ Stock's already ripping on the news and I'm honestly relieved I didn't panic-sell like I almost did. Added more shares this morning instead.
Just saw the $KSAC lawsuit headline and yeah, I'm out. 📉📉 Account's already down enough this month, not waiting around to find out how this one plays. 😬
